method: Reuses the coordinate already recorded on site:kamioka-kamland verbatim (36.4225 N, 137.3153 E), itself the Wikipedia infobox value for KamLAND (rank 12); no additional computation is performed. No source fetched this session (the KamLAND overview arXiv:physics/0404071, the Antineutrino Science in KamLAND review arXiv:1409.4515, or the combined pre-supernova-alert paper arXiv:2404.09920) states a numeric distance-and-bearing offset from Super-Kamiokande precise enough to derive a better point; a WebSearch summary reports "500 m" but no fetched primary source states it, so it is not used (nothing from memory/unfetched summaries). accuracy_m matches the reused coordinate's own precision_m (2000 m) exactly, so this does not rest on a coarser anchor than its own claimed accuracy.
